name: Absorbing Tattoo Color
issue: The exported Foundry table assigns ranges 5-10 to Yellow, Black, Violet, Silver, Gold, and Orange. The official book assigns those ranges to Black, Silver, Gold, Yellow, Orange, and Violet.
decision: Translate the exported result names without changing their IDs or ranges so the translation module does not alter upstream mechanics.

name: Legendry of Phantoms and Ghosts
issue: The official table identifies result 10 as Legendry of Phantoms and Ghosts, but the exported Obsidian Human Molar item duplicates the Beyond the Rock of Bral content.
decision: Use the official Spanish table title, Leyendas de fantasmas y espectros, for the RollTable result. Keep the duplicated item mechanics unchanged because they originate upstream.
